CORPORATE PROFILE
公司簡介
China Modern Dairy Holdings Limited (the “Company” or “Modern Dairy”
together with its subsidiaries, the “Group”) is the leading dairy farming operator
and raw milk producer in the People’s Republic of China (the “PRC”). Modern
Dairy operates 41 dairy farming companies in the PRC with dairy cows over
400,000 heads and annualized milk yield of over 2.36 million tons. The Group
is a leading dairy farming operator and raw milk producer in terms of herd size
in the PRC. The Company initiated the production model of “Zero-distance
Integration of Forage Grass Planting, Cows Breeding and Milk Processing within
Two Hours”, which is the first in the PRC that applies integrated production
model with SGS certification. Modern Dairy’s products have been awarded the
Gold Prize of Monde Selection which is generally regarded as the “Nobel Prize”
in the food industry, for the past nine consecutive years.

中國現代牧業控股有限公司（ 「本公司」或「現代牧業」連同其附屬公司「本集團」
                                     ），
為中華人民共和國（「中國」
            ）乳牛畜牧營運商及原料奶生產商的翹楚。現代牧業於
中國經營41家乳牛牧場公司，擁有逾40萬頭乳牛，年化產奶量達236萬噸以上。
按畜群大小計算，就畜群規模，本集團是中國乳牛畜牧營運商及原料奶生產商
的行業翹楚。本公司首創「種養加一體化、零距離2小時」的生產模式，是中國首
家一體化生產模式並通過SGS認證的企業。現代牧業的產品於過去九年連續在
素有食品業「諾貝爾獎」之稱的世界食品品質評鑒大會中獲得金獎。

 SOCIAL RESPONSIBILITY                                                    社會責任
 Upholding the principle of “safety and quality come first”,              本集團積極履行社會責任，秉持安全質量為先的
 the Group is proactive when it comes to fulfilling its social            原則，努力在發展業務與社會責任之間取得平
 responsibility. The Group devotes great effort to strike a balance       衡，讓廣大持份者感受到本集團傳遞的關愛和幸
 between business growth and social responsibility, so as to convey       福。本集團踐行為消費者提供健康安全、營養豐
 the Group’s care and blessing to all stakeholders. The Group is          富、品質優異乳品的承諾，致力提升產品質量，
 committed to improving the quality of its products by providing          同時秉承實現節能環保的生產原則。
 consumers with a commitment to provide healthy, safe, nutritious
 and high-quality dairy products. Meanwhile, it adheres to the
 production principle of energy conservation and environmental
 protection.

 The Group actively promotes the economic development of the              本集團積極帶動牧場所在週邊經濟發展，增加當

            Provisions                                                        撥備
            Provisions are recognised when the Group has a present            倘本集團因過往事件而須承擔現時責

            settle that obligation, and a reliable estimate can be            計，則確認撥備。
            made of the amount of the obligation.

            The amount recognised as a provision is the best                  確認為撥備之金額乃經計及有關責任
            estimate of the consideration required to settle                  之風險及不確定因素後，對於報告期

            surrounding the obligation. When a provision is                   需之現金流量計量時，其賬面值為有
            measured using the cash flows estimated to settle the             關現金流量之現值（倘貨幣時間價值之
            present obligation, its carrying amount is the present            影響屬重大）。
            value of those cash flows (where the effect of the time
            value of money is material).

            When some or all of the economic benefits required to             當清償撥備所需的部分或全部經濟利
            settle a provision are expected to be recovered from a            益預期可從第三方收回時，如果幾乎
            third party, a receivable is recognised as an asset if it is      可以肯定會收到償付並且應收款的金
            virtually certain that reimbursement will be received and         額能夠可靠地計量，則應收款確認為
            the amount of the receivable can be measured reliably.            一項資產。

            Contingent liabilities                                            或然負債
            A contingent liability is a present obligation arising            或然負債是指因過去事項而產生的現
            from past events but is not recognised because it is              時義務，但因履行該義務不太可能需
            not probable that an outflow of resources embodying               要體現經濟利益的資源流出或該義務
            economic benefits will be required to settle the                  的金額不能足夠可靠地計量，故不予
            obligation or the amount of the obligation cannot be              確認。
            measured with sufficient reliability.

            The Group assesses continually to determine whether               本集團持續評估以確定體現經濟利益
            an outflow of resources embodying economic benefits               的資源是否可能流出。如果以前作為
            has become probable. If it becomes probable that an               或然負債處理的項目很可能需要未來
            outflow of future economic benefits will be required for          經濟利益的流出，於發生概率變化的
            an item previously dealt with as a contingent liability,          報告期內，在綜合財務報表中確認一
            a provision is recognised in the consolidated financial           項撥備，但無法作出可靠估計的極少
            statements in the reporting period in which the change            數情況除外。
            in probability occurs, except in the extremely rare
            circumstances where no reliable estimate can be made.

    A – Nature of activities (continued)                                A – 業務性質（續）
    The Group is exposed to fair value risks arising from changes       本集團要承受原料奶價格變動帶來的公平值
    in price of raw milk. The Group does not anticipate that            風險。據本集團預計，在可預見的將來原料
    the price of the raw milk will decline significantly in the         奶價格不會大幅下跌。董事認為，本集團並
    foreseeable future and the Directors are of the view that there     無可用的衍生工具或其他可以訂立的合約用
    is no available derivative or other contracts which the Group       於管理原料奶價格下跌的風險。
    can enter into to manage the risk of a decline in the price of
    the raw milk.

    In general, the heifers are inseminated with semen when             一般情況下，小母牛於長至約十四個月大時
    heifers reached approximately 14 months old. After an               進行配種。約九個月的孕期過後，小牛出
    approximately nine months’ pregnancy term, a calf is born           生，奶牛開始生產原料奶及哺乳期開始。奶
    and the dairy cow begins to produce raw milk and the                牛通常會擠奶約340天，之後進入約60天的
    lactation period begins. A milkable cow is typically milked for     乾乳期。
    approximately 340 days before a dry period of approximately
    60 days.

    When a heifer begins to produce raw milk, it is transferred         當小母牛開始產原料奶時，乃按轉撥日期的
    to the category of milkable cows based on the estimated fair        估計公平值轉撥至奶牛類別。
    value on the date of transfer.

   The Group manages its capital to ensure that entities in              本集團的資金管理旨在確保本集團旗下實體
   the Group will be able to continue as a going concern                 的持續經營能力，同時透過優化債務及股本
   while maximising the return to stakeholders through the               結餘為利益相關者謀求最大回報。本集團的
   optimisation of the debt and equity balance. The Group’s              整體策略較去年保持不變。
   overall strategy remains unchanged from prior year.

   includes bank borrowings, other borrowings, short term                款、其他借款、短期融資券及長期債券（分

   equity attributable to owners of the Company, comprising              已發行股本、股份溢價及儲備）組成。
   issued share capital, share premium and reserves.

   The Group’s management reviews the capital structure                  本集團的管理層定期檢討資本架構。作為檢
   on a regular basis. As part of the review, the management             討的一環，管理層會考慮資本成本及各類資
